attempts.summary: Repaired worker.py with signal-safe reload/termination handling. SIGHUP now reloads valid messages in the same process, empty configurations retain the last valid message, and SIGTERM exits with status 0. The original journal entry was preserved; verification increased the journal from 1 to 19 entries. RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, SELinux enforcing, ownership, and permissions remain intact.
